LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.condEntropy_chann: For a finite family of finite channels used independently given an input vector X of arbitrary joint law, the conditional output entropy decomposes as H(Y | X) = ∑ᵢ H(Yᵢ | Xᵢ).
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.sum_mutualInfo_su: Let X and Y be the input and output vectors of a product of finitely many channels, each with finite input and output alphabets. For any joint input law, the mutual-information gap ∑ᵢ I(Xᵢ;Yᵢ) − I(X;Y) equals the output entropy gap ∑ᵢ H(Yᵢ) − H(Y).
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.mutualInfo_channe: For a finite product channel acting on any joint input law, the mutual information of the full vectors satisfies I(X;Y) ≤ ∑ᵢ I(Xᵢ;Yᵢ).
For a finite product channel with any joint input law, I(X;Y) = ∑ᵢ I(Xᵢ;Yᵢ) if and only if the output coordinates are mutually independent under their joint output law.
For a finite product channel with independent input coordinates drawn from their respective laws, vector mutual information is additive: I(X;Y) = ∑ᵢ I(Xᵢ;Yᵢ).
For n independent draws from p over n uses of the same finite memoryless channel, block mutual information is n times the single-use mutual information under p.
